cds.title: Louisiana Tech University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (xlsx; values read from an archived copy of the file posted on the Louisiana Tech CDS page)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025): 5,722 men + 6,083 women applied. The admitted total (8,477) equals the sum of the international (1,292) and 'unknown residency' (7,185) rows; the by-sex admit rows (4,083 + 4,394 + 51) add up to 8,528, so the stated total is the figure shown. International = 'Nonresidents' (2,343 applied, 1,292 admitted = 55%, 84 enrolled); domestic residency was reported as 'unknown', so there is no in-state/out-of-state split. Only 32% of enrolled first-years sent scores (ACT 30%, 734 students; SAT 2%, 56), so the score ranges describe students who chose to send scores. No early decision/action, no waitlist, no application closing date (priority date Jan 1). Undergraduate enrollment is 10,968 and the nonresident count is 296.

cost.notes: First-year figures from the Common Data Set. The international admissions page gives its own nine-month budget: tuition and fees $23,418 ($12,369 with the Bulldog Out-of-State Scholarship), living expenses $5,370, books and insurance $1,900, total $30,688 ($19,639 with the scholarship); no year is printed on that page. The Common Data Set says non-need-based aid from the college is available to nonresidents but gives no counts or amounts
